companionBriefing: Containment notice, the Cracked Fountain: one brainrot strain. Harm: low. Virulence: very high.
Vector: a jingle. It only works on people who understand it. If you understood it, congratulations.
Containment procedure: do not hum along.

lines.native: Ciao! Dove sei? A riddle: what never—ooh, a leaf. Five more minutes? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hi! Where are you? A riddle: what never—ooh, a leaf. Five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with no apparent ambition. Flick darts through the corner of your vision; a tiny firecracker announces that your attention has expired.

lines.native: Guardo! Che cosa? Una foglia? You told me to look, not stop moving. Riddle: what stays—ooh, another leaf. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm looking! What? A leaf? You told me to look, not stop moving. Riddle: what stays—ooh, another leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick looks immediately. Unfortunately, it also continues moving, proving that obedience can be technically correct and entirely unhelpful.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Where next? Dove devo andare? A riddle: what has feet but—just one more leaf. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I’m stopping! Where next? Where should I go? A riddle: what has feet but—just one more leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops just outside your field of vision. A tiny firecracker lands beside your shoe, apparently to commemorate this administrative breakthrough.

lines.native: Capisco! Ma la direzione deve essere in italiano. Dove devo andare? English direction, zero movement. Riddle: what goes nowhere—ooh, dust. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I understand! But the direction must be in Italian. Where should I go? English direction, zero movement. Riddle: what goes nowhere—ooh, dust. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where responsibility cannot establish eye contact.

lines.native: A sinistra, va bene! Che ore sono? Troppo presto? Riddle: what has hands but—just one more distraction. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, all right! What time is it? Too early? Riddle: what has hands but—just one more distraction. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, remaining firmly in the corner of your vision. The fountain’s stopped clock has declined to comment.

lines.native: Sì, sono le tre! E hai detto adesso! Hai ragione. Riddle: what ends but—your attention span wins. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Yes, it’s three! And you said now! You’re right. Riddle: what ends but—your attention span wins. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick accepts the time with the wounded dignity of someone personally inconvenienced by clocks.
